create_MSELPIPSLoss_default: create an MSELPIPSLoss instance with default MSE and LPIPS parameters for image distortion loss
create_MSELPIPSLoss_custom_params: create an MSELPIPSLoss with custom mse_param, lpips_param, and backbone for weighted distortion
call_MSELPIPSLoss_compute: call MSELPIPSLoss with image and reference tensors to compute combined MSE and LPIPS loss
review_MSELPIPSLoss_init: review the MSELPIPSLoss constructor to understand how mse_param and lpips_param scale the loss terms
test_MSELPIPSLoss_call: test MSELPIPSLoss by passing two tensors and verifying the returned combined loss value
